description: A .NET MAUI Windows app crashes or hangs when a wrapping FlexLayout contains an image button and the window is too narrow, from https://github.com/dotnet/maui/issues/21548.
prompt:
On Windows our toolbar page sometimes freezes on startup and sometimes throws a layout-cycle crash after the window is resized narrow. It started after we moved from MAUI 8.0.7 to 8.0.10.

```
Layout cycle detected. Layout could not complete.
```
